The '''low-feedback scanner''' was a type of [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] produced by [[CryonCorp/Legends|CryonCorp]].<ref name="FiB" />

Designed for use by [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] and other species sensitive to the electromagnetic spectrum, the low-feedback scanner only made use of passive collection technologies. Due to the passive nature of the scanner, it was essentially invisible to sensor sweeps and scans, making it a common piece of equipment in special forces units. The low-feedback scanner was capable of detecting various phenomena at long range, including [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], life forms, power sources, and comm signals.<ref name="FiB" />

The low-feedback scanner was often carried by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] commandos. The [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] carried these during their mission to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker]].<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
